Class MapComparisonMetrics

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.MapComparisonMetrics
public class MapComparisonMetrics extends Object
Advanced Mathematical Spatial Tensor invalid input: '&' Map Comparison Engine. Provides quantitative cartographic metrics to compare real-world historical spatial data against simulation scenario states, or to compare multi-channel spatial tensors across scenario runs. Metrics implemented: - Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) - Pearson Spatial Cross-Correlation (r) - Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) - Jaccard Index / Dice Coefficient (for categorical sovereignty invalid input: '&' isogloss layers) - Kullback-Leibler (KL) Spatial Divergence
Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • compareCellsToRaster

      public static MapComparisonMetrics.MapComparisonResult compareCellsToRaster(List<H3Cell> cells, BufferedImage groundTruthRaster, double minLat, double maxLat, double minLng, double maxLng, boolean windowed)
      Compares an H3 discrete cellular mesh directly against an authentic empirical ground-truth raster by evaluating density at cell centroids without introducing equirectangular rasterization discretization error.
      Parameters:
      cells - list of simulation cells with spatial coordinates and population/density values
      groundTruthRaster - authentic empirical reference raster (HYDE 3.4 / WorldClim)
      minLat - minimum latitude (-90 to 90)
      maxLat - maximum latitude (-90 to 90)
      minLng - minimum longitude (-180 to 180)
      maxLng - maximum longitude (-180 to 180)
      windowed - whether the evaluation is restricted to a regional bounding box
      Returns:
      quantitative comparison result over the cellular domain

    • compareCellsToCells

      public static MapComparisonMetrics.MapComparisonResult compareCellsToCells(List<H3Cell> cellsA, List<H3Cell> cellsB, String channelKey)
      Directly compares two H3 cellular meshes (e.g. Scenario A vs Scenario B) across physical channels, computing direct Pearson spatial correlation, ecumene overlap (Dice/Jaccard), SSIM, and RMSE without any intermediate 2D equirectangular rasterization.
      Parameters:
      cellsA - list of H3 cells for scenario A
      cellsB - list of H3 cells for scenario B
      channelKey - target physical channel name (e.g. "density", "temperature", "aquifer")
      Returns:
      quantitative comparison result over the cellular mesh domain

    • compareImages

    • compareImagesWindowed

      public static MapComparisonMetrics.MapComparisonResult compareImagesWindowed(BufferedImage imgA, BufferedImage imgB, double minLat, double maxLat, double minLng, double maxLng)
      Compares two multi-channel spatial images restricted to a specific geographic bounding box. Essential for windowed/regional scenarios (e.g. Nile Valley, Mediterranean, Fertile Crescent) to avoid false divergence against unsimulated regions.
      Parameters:
      imgA - simulated raster
      imgB - empirical ground truth raster
      minLat - minimum latitude (-90 to 90)
      maxLat - maximum latitude (-90 to 90)
      minLng - minimum longitude (-180 to 180)
      maxLng - maximum longitude (-180 to 180)
      Returns:
      quantitative comparison result over the windowed sub-grid
